scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Whoa, long time no see! But weren't you supposed to be dead?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
哇，好久不见！不过你不是应该已经死了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Ah, you must have been reborn. Well, I'm glad to have you back.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
啊，看来你是转生了。很高兴你能回来。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
I'm sorry, but I don't think you're ready to learn magic yet. Why don't you go finish learning the Basic Skills first?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
抱歉，我觉得你还没准备好学习魔法。不如先去把基本技能学完吧？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Take your time. The more you learn, the more ready you'll be to learn magic again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
慢慢来。你学得越多，就越能准备好重新学习魔法。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Well, since you have passed the Mage test once, I will not question your qualification. You want to have your magic skills back immediately, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
既然你已经通过了一次魔法师考试，我就不会再质疑你的资质了。你是想立刻恢复魔法技能吧？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wow, for some reason, you look way better than you did before. Anyway, I believe you will do a better job being a Mage as well.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
哇，不知道为什么，你看起来比以前好多了。总之，我相信你作为魔法师会做得更好的。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Is there anything more I can help you with? If not, why don't you go test your skills? The world is waiting for you~!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
还有什么我可以帮你的吗？如果没有的话，不如去试试你的技能吧。世界在等着你哦~！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
What, are you interested in the Mage guild? I didn't want to tell you this, but you don't belong here.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
什么，你对魔法师公会感兴趣？我不想告诉你，但你并不属于这里。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
I am not sure why you're still standing in front of me, but I can tell that you're not meant to be a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
我不知道你为什么还站在我面前，但我看得出来，你不适合当魔法师。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yo. What's up?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嘿。有什么事吗？

scripts.text: I want to be a Mage.
scripts.translation: 我想成为魔法师。

scripts.text: Tell me the Requirements.
scripts.translation: 告诉我要求。

scripts.text: Pretty much nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么特别的。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey, haven't you realized? You're aleady a Mage, silly!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嘿，你没发现吗？你已经是魔法师了，笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey~ C'mon. Quit playing games. You can't be a Mage because you already have another Job.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嘿~ 别闹了。你已经有其他职业了，所以不能成为魔法师。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh...?
Hey, look at you! You're kinda cute~! Not my type though...
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
想当魔法师啊...？
嘿，看看你！挺可爱的~！不过不是我喜欢的类型...

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh...?
Oooh, you're such a hot babe~!
I like girls like you~
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
想当魔法师啊...？
哦，你真是个大美女~！
我喜欢像你这样的女孩~

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
Oh, what a bummer. You haven't met the requirements yet.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
是吗？准备好了...？
哎呀，真遗憾。你还没达到要求。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
{0}'s test was...
Making Mixed Solution No. 1.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
是吗？准备好了...？
{0}的考试是...
制作混合溶液1号。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
{0}'s test was...
Making Mixed Solution No. 2.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
是吗？准备好了...？
{0}的考试是...
制作混合溶液2号。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
{0}'s test was...
Making Mixed Solution No. 3.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
是吗？准备好了...？
{0}的考试是...
制作混合溶液3号。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
{0}'s test was...
Making Mixed Solution No. 4.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
是吗？准备好了...？
{0}的考试是...
制作混合溶液4号。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
One of these days you'll realize the power inside of you when you can make Fire with your mind!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
总有一天，当你学会用心念制造火焰时，你就会意识到自己体内的力量！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Right, you said that you wanna be a Mage? Alright then, please sign the Mage Application.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
好的，你说你想当魔法师？那么，请签署魔法师申请表。

scripts.text: Sign Up.
scripts.translation: 报名

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Okay. Sign right there. Oh, you're very good at spelling. Alright. So your name is... {0}.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
好的。就签在那里。哦，你的拼写很准确。那么，你的名字是... {0}。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now it's time for
me to give you the test.
Make me a ^3355FFMixed Solution No. 1^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
现在该我出题了。
请制作一份^3355FF混合溶液1号^000000
并带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now it's time for
me to give you the test.
Make me a ^3355FFMixed Solution No. 2^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
现在该我出题了。
请制作一份^3355FF混合溶液2号^000000
并带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now it's time for
me to give you the test.
Make me a ^3355FFMixed Solution No. 3^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
现在该我出题了。
请制作一份^3355FF混合溶液3号^000000
并带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now it's time for
me to give you the test.
Make me a ^3355FFMixed Solution No. 4^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
现在该我出题了。
请制作一份^3355FF混合溶液4号^000000
并带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You can find the necessary ingredients inside the Guide Book in this Guild. So you better look up what you need before you go.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你可以在本公会的指南手册中找到所需的材料。所以，出发前最好先查一下你需要什么。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Once you collect all the ingredients you, use the machine in the center of the room to mix the solution. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
收集齐所有材料后，使用房间中央的机器混合溶液。祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Whaaaaat~?! Right after you tell me that you wanna become a Mage, you change your mind?! Be a bit more decisive!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
什...么~？！刚说完想当魔法师，你就反悔了？！能不能果断一点！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Go back and reach Novice Job level 9 first. Don't forget that you also have to learn all of the Basic Skills before you come back.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
先回去达到初心者职业等级9吧。别忘了，回来之前你还需要学会所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Okay, let me
check if you made your
solution accurately...
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
好的，让我
检查一下你制作的
溶液是否准确...

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey, where's the Solution
I asked for...? I can't check it if you don't show it to me, right?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嘿，我要的溶液
在哪里...？你不拿给我看，我怎么检查呢，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wait.
This isn't the
Solution I asked for!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
等等。
这不是我要求的
溶液！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hmm. I can see that you tried really hard. For a beginner's attempt, this is really good.
Great work!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嗯。看得出你很努力。作为初学者的尝试，这真的很不错。
干得好！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 1 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你应该制作混合溶液1号并带回来给我。现在，去再试一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 2 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你应该制作混合溶液2号并带回来给我。现在，去再试一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 3 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你应该制作混合溶液3号并带回来给我。现在，去再试一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 4 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你应该制作混合溶液4号并带回来给我。现在，去再试一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Alright! I'm pleased to say that you've passed the Mage Test. I will transform you right away!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
很好！很高兴地告诉你，你通过了魔法师测试。我马上为你进行转职！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
*Ahem*
Congratulations!
You are now a Mage!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
*咳*
恭喜！
你现在是一名魔法师了！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
'Welcome to My World~'
Heh heh, I just wanted to say that. You know, it's a quote from a well-known movie~
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
“欢迎来到我的世界~”
嘿嘿，我只是想这么说而已。你知道的，这是一句著名电影里的台词~

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now that you're a Mage just like us, let's be friends, okay?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
既然你现在和我们要一样是魔法师了，那我们交个朋友吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh?
For a cutie like you, I'd be happy to explain the requirements!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
想成为魔法师吗？
像你这样可爱的人，我很乐意为你解释转职要求！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh?
I'd be happy to explain the requirements for a pretty girl like you!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
想成为魔法师吗？
像你这样漂亮的女孩，我很乐意为你解释转职要求！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
First of all, you have to reach Novice Job Level 10 and learn all of the Basic Skills. Then, you'll have to pass the Mage Test.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
首先，你必须达到初心者职业等级10，并学会所有基本技能。然后，你需要通过魔法师测试。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Your test is to
make me a
^3355FFMixed Solution No. 1^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你的测试任务是制作
^3355FF混合溶液1号^000000
并带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Your test is to
make me a
^3355FFMixed Solution No. 2^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你的测试任务是制作
^3355FF混合溶液2号^000000
并带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Your test is to
make me a
^3355FFMixed Solution No. 3^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你的测试任务是制作
^3355FF混合溶液3号^000000
并带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Your test is to
make me a
^3355FFMixed Solution No. 4^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你的测试任务是制作
^3355FF混合溶液4号^000000
并带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You can look up the ingredients you'll need to make the Solution inside the Guide Book in this Guild.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你可以在本公会的指南手册中查看制作溶液所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You will be informed as to which Mixed Solution you will need to create after signing the application form.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
在签署申请表后，你会被告知需要制作哪种混合溶液。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Let me know when you are ready to become a Mage, alright?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
当你准备好成为魔法师时，请告诉我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Nothing...?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
没有...？

scripts.text:
[Mixing Machine]
This machine is the property of the Geffen Mage Guild and is used only for mixing solutions for magic purposes.
scripts.translation:
[混合机]
这台机器是吉芬魔法师公会的财产，仅用于混合魔法用途的溶液。

- Proverb of the Day -
An Eye for an Eye: When you take from a person, you must replace or repay in some way.
scripts.translation:
[混合机]
- 今日谚语 -
以眼还眼：当你从他人那里索取时，必须以某种方式偿还或补偿。

scripts.text:

Credibility is a Man's Currency: There's a value in genuine trust that cannot be measured.

[混合机]

scripts.text:
[Mixing Machine]
- Proverb of the Day -
What Goes Around Comes Around: Ultimately, you will be treated in the way you treat others.
It means 'When you harm Another you will be harmed by him in an unavoidable situation'.
scripts.translation:
[混合机]
- 今日谚语 -
善有善报，恶有恶报：最终，你会以对待他人的方式被对待。
意思是“当你伤害他人时，在不可避免的情况下，你也会受到他的伤害”。

scripts.text:

- Proverb of the Day -
A good neighbor is better than a distant brother: When you need help, you can count on those close to you.
scripts.translation:
[混合机]
- 今日谚语 -

scripts.text:
[Mixing Machine]
- Proverb of the Day -
Birds of a Feather Flock Together: You can look at a person's friends as an indicator of their character.
scripts.translation:
[混合机]
- 今日谚语 -
物以类聚：你可以通过一个人的朋友来判断他的品格。
